question: What universal role does this presence play in the minds of sages?
premises: She has become the life of all beings.
She acts within the minds of sages.
She joyfully bears knowledge of truth.
inference: As the life of all, she brings joyful knowledge of truth into the minds of sages.
plain_english: Having become the life of all, she joyfully bears the knowledge of truth in the minds of sages.
